title: Coral and the Crown
premise: Emrys Pemberton has spent six years hiding his hedge-magic in the smuggler's passes of the Thornfell mountains, until a royal edict orders every gifted person seized or burned. Captured by a hunt captain who turns out to be a woman he once loved, he is dragged to the capital—where he discovers the king is not a man but a hollowed vessel, worn like a crown by an ancient parasite that feeds on magic itself. To save the realm, Emrys must unbind the dying king, ally with the very hunters sent to kill him, and sacrifice the last of his own gift. In the end, the parasite is destroyed, the true heir—a child no one knew survived—is crowned, and Emrys, now ordinary and free, chooses love over the invisibility that once kept him alive.
about_author: Cyrus Quintana is a former cartographer who spent a decade mapping mountain passes across three continents before turning to fiction. He writes fantasy rooted in landscapes, smuggling routes, and the quiet people history forgets.

chapters.title: The Smuggler's Arithmetic
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. He runs contraband and small charms through Thornfell's passes, calculating every risk down to the copper coin. When news of the gift-hunt reaches a mountain inn, he weighs fleeing against the one client he can't abandon. Emotional beat: the uneasy comfort of a life built on staying unseen.

chapters.title: Ash on the Wind
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. He finds his old master's cottage burned and her gone, leaving only her grimoire's missing final page as a clue. A hunter's patrol nearly takes him; he escapes using magic he swore off, revealing himself. Emotional beat: grief curdling into fear—the invisible life is over.

chapters.title: The Captain in Grey
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. Ambushed at a river ford, he is captured by Captain Sera Vane—the girl he loved before he ran from his apprenticeship. She doesn't recognize him at first, or pretends not to. Emotional beat: recognition as a wound reopened.

chapters.title: Chains and Ciphers
chapters.summary: Sera's POV. Escorting Emrys toward the capital, she wrestles with the edict's cruelty and her own doubts about what the hunters are told to do with prisoners. Emrys deciphers a coded warning sewn into his bindings. Emotional beat: duty beginning to crack.

chapters.title: What the Road Remembers
chapters.summary: Dual POV. An ambush by desperate fugitive witches forces Sera and Emrys to fight side by side; she sees his magic used only to protect. They share memories of the years between them. Emotional beat: reluctant trust kindling into something older.

chapters.title: The Gilded Cage
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. Arriving in the capital, he is imprisoned beneath the palace rather than executed—an order signed by the king himself. He glimpses the monarch through bars: a man whose shadow moves wrong. Emotional beat: dread sharpening into terrible curiosity.

chapters.title: The Hollow King
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. Brought before the throne, Emrys realizes the king is a puppet—the thing wearing him devours magic, which is why it hunts the gifted: to feed. It offers Emrys survival in exchange for servitude. Emotional beat: horror and the temptation of safety.

chapters.title: Sera's Oath
chapters.summary: Sera's POV. Ordered to execute the captured witches, Sera refuses in secret and falsifies records, discovering the hunt's true purpose in sealed dispatches. She visits Emrys's cell at night. Emotional beat: the moment loyalty to the crown dies.

chapters.title: The Missing Page
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. He realizes his master's stolen final page contained the unbinding ritual—and that she was taken, not killed, because she knew it. The parasite plans to wear her next. Emotional beat: guilt transformed into resolve.

chapters.title: Bargains in the Dark
chapters.summary: Dual POV. Emrys and Sera strike an uneasy alliance with a imprisoned witch-elder who knows the palace's old passages. The escape plan requires Sera to betray her own company. Emotional beat: choosing each other over survival.

chapters.title: The Breaking of the Hunt
chapters.summary: Sera's POV. She turns her hunter company against their commander, half defecting, half falling. The city's bells announce treason. Emotional beat: the cost of conscience made bloodily real.

chapters.title: Under the Palace Bones
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. Through forgotten crypts, the fugitives find evidence of the parasite's origin: it was bound to the crown generations ago by a king who feared death. Every heir since has been hollowed. Emotional beat: the scale of the lie revealed.

chapters.title: The Elder's Price
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. The witch-elder reveals the unbinding requires a living anchor with the gift—one who will lose all their magic, perhaps their life. Emrys volunteers before anyone else can. Emotional beat: quiet, terrifying self-sacrifice.

chapters.title: Sera's Choice
chapters.summary: Sera's POV. Learning of Emrys's bargain, Sera rages at being asked to watch him die again. They argue, then confess what they never said six years ago. Emotional beat: love named aloud at last, which makes everything harder.

chapters.title: The Master's Cell
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. Rescuing his master from the parasite's feeding vaults, he finds her drained nearly empty; she gives him the ritual's final words and forgives the boy who ran. Emotional beat: reconciliation and inheritance.

chapters.title: A Child in the Walls
chapters.summary: Sera's POV. Hiding in the palace undercrofts, they discover a surviving royal infant smuggled away years ago by a loyal nurse—the one person the parasite cannot wear. Hope acquires a face. Emotional beat: the future suddenly has an heir.

chapters.title: The Night of Long Bells
chapters.summary: Dual POV. The parasite, sensing the plot, unleashes the hunt upon the city; streets burn with anti-gift pogroms while the fugitives race for the throne room. Emotional beat: desperation, the city paying for its king's secret.

chapters.title: The Unbinding
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. In the throne room, Emrys begins the ritual as the parasite tears at his mind with visions of every life he could have had if he surrendered. His master's words hold him steady. Emotional beat: endurance at the edge of annihilation.

chapters.title: Coral and Crown
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. Climax: Sera holds the hunters' line while Emrys pours his entire gift into the unbinding, prying the parasite from the dying king. It tries to leap to Emrys—but finds nothing left to grip. Emotional beat: victory purchased with everything he was.

chapters.title: What Remains of Emrys
chapters.summary: Sera's POV. Emrys survives, magicless and half-blind, cradled in the ruined throne room. The old king dies human at last, whispering thanks. Emotional beat: grief and tenderness entwined.

chapters.title: The Smallest Coronation
chapters.summary: Dual POV. The child heir is crowned quietly, with Sera named protector of the realm and amnesty declared for the gifted. Emrys watches from the crowd, ordinary for the first time. Emotional beat: a kingdom exhaling.

chapters.title: The Road Without Charms
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. Epilogue: Emrys and Sera walk out of the capital together toward Thornfell, carrying his master's grimoire to rebuild what was burned. He maps roads now just to walk them. Emotional beat: freedom chosen, love kept, identity remade.
